{"id":"__talon_community-1gq","title":"Epic: tmux voice integration","notes":"Epic tracking full tmux voice control integration for Talon.

## Goal
Comprehensive voice commands for tmux on macOS (and cross-platform where possible), plus automatic detection of tmux sessions.

## Current State
- tmux.py: actions for prefix, keybind, command execution, tab/split management
- tmux.talon: only 'go split' commands, requires manual user.tmux tag activation
- tmux_linux.talon: Linux-only 'mux' commands (sessions, windows, panes) — NOT active on macOS

## Key Gaps
1. No auto-detection of tmux sessions (must manually activate tag)
2. No macOS tmux voice commands (linux .talon is gated on os: linux)
3. Missing commands: session management, copy mode, resize, rename, sync panes, command prompt
4. No status bar / info commands

## Sub-tasks (file as separate beads blocking this epic)
- [ ] Detect tmux session automatically (TMUX env var, title matching, or terminal query)
- [ ] Cross-platform session management commands (new, attach, detach, list, kill, rename)
- [ ] Cross-platform window management commands (new, rename, switch, close, list)
- [ ] Cross-platform pane management commands (split, navigate, resize, close, zoom, swap)
- [ ] Copy mode commands (enter, navigate, select, yank)
- [ ] Miscellaneous commands (reload config, command prompt, sync panes, show info)","status":"open","priority":1,"issue_type":"feature","owner":"trillium@trilliumsmith.com","created_at":"2026-03-13T04:07:30Z","created_by":"Trillium Smith","updated_at":"2026-03-13T04:07:30Z"}
